Just now on @clayandbuck border tsar Tom Homan says, “You’re damn right,” when asked if ICE will arrest illegal immigrants at airports.

15 year old benched 205 this week. Real Sputnik moment for me in the house, didn’t think my strength superiority would be challenged for a long time. I either have to get stronger or kick him out of the house.

Today’s @nytimes features a completely logical and fair opinion piece — shocking, I know — that everything in Iran is going supremely well, far better than most military actions in the past forty years. Better than Panama and Desert Storm. Read it: nytimes.com/2026/03/24/opini…

NBA ratings are at multi-decade lows for the NBA Finals. The NBA’s all time most watched game was in 1998. This year the NCAA tourney is setting all time record viewership. The Super Bowl all time high was two years ago. Why has NBA tanked while other leagues soared? Vote below.

USC canceled a California gubernatorial debate because all six qualifying candidates were white. Thank the lord. I am so sick of the constant racism in California. If trans black midgets aren’t included in every California debate they should all be canceled for lack of diversity.

It’s virtually impossible, in my opinion, to explain why men’s and women’s college basketball is at all time highs and the NBA is at all time lows without pointing to the NBA’s woke politics as the most likely culprit. But I’m curious to see above results.
One additional point is the game is just a three point shooting contest now. It’s pretty much pick and rolls that lead to dunks or threes on every possession.

Who should UNC hire now?


OutKick (@Outkick)

Hubert Davis Out: North Carolina faces pressure to hit a home run, especially after spending $10 million a year on Bill Belichick. 

Tar Heels need to go outside the ‘family’ for next hire, in a process that had already started

Who’s next? ✏️ @TreyWallace outkick.com/sports/north-car…




— https://nitter.net/Outkick/status/2036617045467447515#m

Austin, you are really, really dumb. The NBA’s signature event is the NBA Finals. It’s at multi-decade viewership lows. Below is the chart. The NCAA Tourney opening weekend just posted its highest ratings EVER. The NBA’s highest ratings ever were in 1998, nearly 30 years ago.




Austin Karp (@AustinKarp)

And Clay isn’t even right about NBA viewership. 

Average viewership of NBA games across ABC, ESPN, NBC/Peacock and Amazon this season is +13% YOY 

Most-watched NBA regular season in 7 years

I don’t think I have a single sports media critic with an IQ over 100. Your entire job is talking about sports media and you can’t do basic research? It’s embarrassing. Just admit you’re a white dude for Harris and move to BlueSky, bud.

Are there multiple factors that have led to the NBA setting multi decade low ratings? Sure. Load management, tanking, arrogant players & coaches that seem to hate the fans, all of these impact things negatively too. But going woke alienated more people than anything in my always humble opinion. It’s definitely not basketball. The NCAA Tourney ratings prove how much people still love basketball. If sports media were remotely honest they would be looking at these numbers and asking tons of questio

Hey @AustinKarp, take a break from reading your Kamala emails & study this NBA all star game viewership chart below. How would you describe the trend line over the past couple of decades? I don’t work at an august publication like @sbj, but this looks like multi-decade lows to me
